name: Aegi no Yakata 2
source:
Main character stopped going to school in order to work part-time at a construction site. Money is being spent on apartment, gambling and clothes - what kind of life is that? A suspicious man offers him a job to train a girl in ten days, and main character welcomes the opportunity.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公为了在建筑工地打工而辍学。钱都花在了房租、赌博和衣服上——这算什么生活？一个可疑的男人给了他一份在十天内调教一个女孩的工作，主人公欣然接受了这个机会。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
